title: A.R.M.O.R. answer of an electrical node to a switch command
description: What a node answers to a command, published to armor/electrical/{node_id}/result (never retained): whether it accepted the request and, when it did not, why. Accepting a request to close is not the switch being closed: only the `state` message says that. The result of an accepted `arm` carries the one-time `token`.

command_id.description: The command_id of the command answered.

refusal.description: none exactly when the request was accepted.

token.description: Only in the result of an accepted arm.
